_provenance: Curated allele-synonym map for variant-tier reconciliation (design A.1). Each gene maps a CANONICAL token (rsID or primary star allele) to the list of equivalent tokens emitted by different callers (PyPGx star/HGVS, Stargazer S-alleles, Aldy rsID/star). Tokens are matched after lowercasing and stripping copy-number (xN), parentheticals, and sub-allele suffixes. Scoped DELIBERATELY to well-established synonyms only; VKORC1 H-haplotypes and NUDT15 *5/*6 are intentionally EXCLUDED because they are not true synonyms and are handled by array adjudication (A.2). Stargazer S-allele equivalences (*S10=*9A, *S6=*5, *S1=*2A) confirmed by co-occurrence in TTSH validation.
